analysis.reading: THE MARY LEE COLLISION APPEARS IN THE IMAGES BLOCK. A query for «lee sharks rex fraction» returns an image set dominated by MARY LEE THE WHITE SHARK — OCEARCH tracking content from Instagram and YouTube — alongside one Academia card for Ghost Meaning. The text answer resolves the query to the heteronymic corpus; the image retrieval resolves it to the shark. The two surfaces of one capture disagree about who the subject is. The capture also discloses the operator location: "48239, Redford Township, MI - From your device".
